title: Institute of Health hero
description: A full-window video hero under a black scrim. Top right, figures stacked under 2px white rules (small label, big number, three pulsing dots); phones show one figure at a time under a line that fills a third further each time it changes. Bottom left, a large tight headline, a short line of copy and a see-through glass button rise in on load. The numbers count up once, and the hero stays pinned while the next section slides over it.
notes: needs JavaScript for the counters and the phone stat cycle (hydrate: load)
pinned (default): it is sticky to the top of its parent, so wrap everything after it in a `relative z-10` layer with opaque backgrounds, or pass pinned={false}
text sits on dark media in every theme (highlight-foreground on a black scrim)
name: instituteofhealth-hero
